verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a CRM, since self-hostable CRMs exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows HubSpot can be deployed on user-controlled infrastructure. The pack describes only the hosted SaaS CRM, its APIs, the CLI and MCP servers; a 'data hosting location' account setting is an adjacent feature, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
